reason: 该插件是用于 DSH Web 的身份访问控制插件，主要面向用户提供登录页和会话门禁，用于在反向代理或公网暴露场景下给 Web 控制台加一层密码访问层。证据显示其主要功能包括 HTTP/WS 请求拦截、密码设置与改密、会话签名与续期、登录限速及监听地址配置，因此分类为插件开发类通用工具。

summaries.zh: dsh-web-auth 是一款 DSH Web 插件，用于为 Web 界面提供登录页并通过会话校验实现密码访问保护。
summaries.en: dsh-web-auth is a DSH web plugin that adds a login page and session-based access checks to gate DSH Web access with a password.

capabilities: Enforces login access control for web requests and WebSocket upgrades.
Stores and verifies access credentials with scrypt hashing and signed session cookies.
Applies per-IP rate limiting for login/password-change operations.
Provides logout, password rotation, and session invalidation behavior.
Offers UI-driven host listen-address switching with HMR-based webserver rebinding.
